# BCrypt.Net-Next 4.2.0 license notice

Retain `LICENSE.txt` alongside redistributed backend binaries and in the backend
runtime image. It contains the official upstream MIT license, including its
copyright notices, permission and disclaimer, copied without rewriting.

| Retained license source | [Root `licence.txt` at the pinned release](https://github.com/BcryptNet/bcrypt.net/blob/c3e7399f797b5ffe02c2fe7e91966947521742c5/licence.txt) |

The 4.2.0 package declares repository commit
`1772bb7a552610cd5c66b79bc208a46ef07107be`; its archive declares an MIT license
expression rather than including a separate license text file. The retained
notice was therefore collected from the explicit upstream v4.2.0 source release,
not inferred from package author metadata or synthesized from a generic template.
The retained bytes were checked against that release's Git blob hash. The
[license at the package's declared repository commit](https://github.com/BcryptNet/bcrypt.net/blob/1772bb7a552610cd5c66b79bc208a46ef07107be/licence.txt)
was also fetched and is byte-identical to the retained release license.

When updating the package, collect and review the corresponding license again.
This notice covers the named dependency; it is not an application-wide license
or a claim about unrelated dependencies or production content.
